world_seed.visual_direction: Brutal seawalls composed of crushed galleon ribs, iron strongboxes, and salt-crusted confiscated furniture jutting into surging teal tidepools.

institutions.name: High Admiralty Court of Forfeiture
institutions.mandate: Condemn illicit coastal cargo and direct heavy contraband directly into littoral breakwater construction.
institutions.decision_rule: Cargo exceeding legal tonnage or lacking excise chops is declared aggregate and ordered sunk into the nearest seawall sector.
institutions.visible_output: Terraced seawalls lined with stamped iron chests, seized vessel keels, and court placards.

institutions.name: Haven Slipway Guild
institutions.mandate: Maintain continuous intertidal ramp access and mooring rights for working fishercraft.
institutions.decision_rule: Quorum of master mariners can declare a court seawall section an unlawful blockage and erect pirate slipways.
institutions.visible_output: Improvised timber ramps spanning across newly raised seawall revetments.

institutions.name: Board of Riprap Assay
institutions.mandate: Certify the structural buoyancy and load-bearing density of confiscated property before shoreline interment.
institutions.decision_rule: High-density contraband is assigned to deep breakwaters; porous wood cargo is assigned to intertidal gabions.
institutions.visible_output: Color-coded chalk grids and salvage permits affixed to coastal aggregate heaps.

state_variables.label: Reclaimed Coastal Extent
state_variables.initial_tension: High seawall advancement threatening historic low-tide alleys
changed_by: Storm erosion and rogue salvage crews

state_variables.label: District Slipway Permeability
state_variables.initial_tension: Outer wards cut off from ocean access by sheer confiscated barricades
changed_by: Court expansion of fortress seawall barriers

state_variables.label: Impounded Cargo Stockpile
state_variables.initial_tension: Warehouses overflowing with unliquidated trade goods slated for shoreline burial
changed_by: Black-market theft from court holding pens

state_variables.label: Seaward Borough Volatility
state_variables.initial_tension: Simmering riots over lost launchways and arbitrary cargo condemnations

causal_links.trigger: Aggressive customs sweeps yield surplus heavy cargo condemned for marine landfill
causal_links.effect: Accelerates the outward expansion of the barrier seawalls into navigable waters

causal_links.trigger: Barrier walls rise above low-water draft limits in working-class coves
causal_links.effect: Cuts off low-ward fishing alleys from open sea while routing access solely through court toll-gates

causal_links.trigger: Maritime access drops below commercial subsistence levels in artisanal districts
causal_links.effect: Incites coordinated dock strikes and clandestine demolition of riprap buttresses

causal_links.trigger: Public riots prompt the Admiralty Court to expand martial confiscation edicts
causal_links.effect: Increases the volume and variety of goods seized from dissenting coastal merchants

stakeholder_groups.name: Low-Cove Fisherfolk
stakeholder_groups.goal: Retain unobstructed tidal ramps and direct launch rights from historic neighborhood channels.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Control of local food supply and intimate knowledge of submerged tidal hazards.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: Access to calm launch basins blocked by growing seawall bulkheads.

stakeholder_groups.name: Justiciars of the Admiralty
stakeholder_groups.goal: Enclose the entire island perimeter in an impenetrable, court-owned perimeter of consolidated contraband.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Sovereign legal authority to seize merchant assets and mobilize public labor.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: Sufficient heavy, durable contraband to prevent ocean surges from breaching the court district.

stakeholder_groups.name: Silt-Trench Free Traders
stakeholder_groups.goal: Exhume high-value smuggled relics and luxury goods from the newly laid shoreline before they are calcified in cement.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Monopoly on off-book transport and diving equipment.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: Lax enforcement and high water turbulence around active construction zones.

premise: On a tide-swept island, the governing Admiralty Court reclaims storm-eroded coastlines entirely out of impounded contraband, constantly shifting which districts can reach the water and reshaping urban power.
simulation_objective: Simulate spatial and economic power struggles as agents divert cargo, demolish seawalls, and contest access to ocean transit.
economy_focus: Material seizure, coastal engineering permits, salvage value, and slipway toll concessions.
exploration_focus: Intertidal excavation, mapping evolving seawall mazes, and underwater ballast salvage.
visual_style: Nautical brutalism with barnacle-encrusted brass, timber hulls embedded in basalt, and chalk-marked masonry.

gameplay_loops.label: Reclamation Foreclosure Cycle
gameplay_loops.summary: Admiralty magistrates condemn seized trade goods and direct engineers to submerge them into expanding barriers, raising shoreline_reclamation_depth and restricting neighborhood_sea_access.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Rising cargo volume forces aggressive shoreline enclosure, threatening to block harbor navigation.

gameplay_loops.label: Slipway Liberation and Smuggling Circuit
gameplay_loops.summary: Fisherfolk and salvage syndicates dredge submerged cargo and construct illicit ramps to maintain neighborhood_sea_access, altering contraband_forfeiture_volume and civic_unrest_level.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Rapid seawall construction creates maritime choke points, pushing the district toward violent dock strikes.

gameplay_loops.label: Ballast Assay and Certification Squeeze
gameplay_loops.summary: Assayers and surveyors inspect impounded assets to allocate riprap density, navigating black-market bribes and forgeries that modulate civic_unrest_level and shoreline_reclamation_depth.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Structural collapse looms if low-density contraband is falsely certified and laid into deep-water foundations.

player_entry_points: A newly appointed Assayer inspecting disputed ballast chests at the Board of Riprap Assay Depot.
A desperate fisherman arriving at Haven Slipway Guild Hall to protest a sealed harbor ramp.
An under-the-table diver smuggling recovered coral gems into the Silt-Trench Salvage Lockup.
conflict_hooks: The High Admiralty decrees the immediate enclosure of Low-Cove launch channels using newly seized foreign merchant vessels as revetment fill.
A massive spring tide threatens to breach the Pioneer Breakwater Buttress unless unassayed contraband is hastily sunk into the breach.
A cache of forged excise stamps is discovered in the Low-Cove Netmending Alley, triggering martial sweeps by the Gate Bastion Enforcer.

open_action_examples.situation: The Fence needs immediate passage through the seawall gate before the incoming tide seals the lower slipway.
coordinator_checks: Proximity: Initiator and target must both be present in the Seawall Toll-Gate Bastion.
Ownership: Initiator must possess the specific uncataloged artifact.
Consent: Target role has the option to reject the bribe and trigger an arrest.

open_action_examples.situation: Registrar seeks to declare an impounded skiff as low-density aggregate to expand the Pioneer Breakwater Buttress.
coordinator_checks: Legality: Registrar must hold the official court seal of condemnation.
Proximity: Both parties must be in the High Admiralty Forfeiture Chamber or Low-Cove Netmending Alley.
Bounded Creation: Resulting ballast ticket must conform to legal cargo item limits.

open_action_examples.situation: Surveyor provides falsified soundings to persuade the Architect to divert breakwater rubble away from secret salvage trenches.
coordinator_checks: Legality: Surveyor must hold drafting implements and valid survey parchment.
Proximity: Both roles must be in the Board of Riprap Assay Depot or Pioneer Breakwater Buttress.
Consent: Architect can perform a verification check to detect fabricated depth figures.

open_action_examples.situation: Guild Leader creates a legally recognized low-tide dock notch within newly reinforced riprap buttresses.
coordinator_checks: Legality: Requires either Assayer approval or an uncontested guild proclamation.
Proximity: Initiator and target must be in the Haven Slipway Guild Hall or Pioneer Breakwater Buttress.
Bounded Creation: Physical ramp item must not exceed spatial district parameters.

social_rules: No confiscated ballast or riprap may be extracted from the shoreline once marked with the High Admiralty lead chop.
Fishercraft must purchase a toll warrant before traversing breakwater gates during neap tide.
Any unmarked salvage hauled from the silt trenches is deemed Admiralty property by default.
Riprap assayers hold the final authority over whether seized luxury goods constitute structurally stable aggregate.

visual_consistency_rules: Sprite resolution is strictly 64x64 pixels rendered from a 90-degree zenith orthographic top-down camera.
All character tokens must use a crisp 1px dark charcoal (#12181a) outer outline without alpha blending.
Role identification must be instantly legible from top-down through high-contrast shoulder markers: white chalk stoles for Admiralty, round brass gear for divers, diagonal rope lines for Guild.
Avoid micro-texturing and sub-pixel dithering; use solid, high-value contrast clusters to maintain readability against crushed basalt and turquoise water tilemaps.
Keep maximum token occupancy within a 48x48 pixel inner circle centered on the 64x64 canvas to avoid clipping during grid movement.

visual_canon.lighting: Harsh overcast zenith daylight casting minimal vertical shadows into shallow brine pools with specular glints on wet stone and iron.

terrain.ground: Crushed shell and wet basalt aggregate densely packed with half-submerged cargo crates
terrain.path: Tarred oak planking and salt-bleached timber catwalks spanning seawall tiers
terrain.edge: Sheer vertical bulkhead drops into surging turquoise tidepools and barnacle colonies
